title: What Does a Score Tell Us? Names, Units, and Comparisons

scenes.title: What does a score tell us?
lines: How can a score display tell us what a game counts and what it evaluates?
We will first separate line counts from points in Tetris, then examine how cards contribute to scoring and how hand results accumulate in Balatro.
Next, we will examine the reference used to compare opponents, then organize score labels and feedback so players can judge what to do next.

scenes.title: Audit the score display
lines: In the Tetris examples, we distinguished line counts, evaluation points, and the gap between opponents. In Balatro, we examined card contributions, hand results versus round totals, and the order in which to read them.
